6.2.2.2.2 Flash driver
Reported by the Flash controller (see Flash controller above).
Detection
Reaction
 [FLS104] The job is aborted.
 [FLS052] The module state is set to MEMIF_IDLE, ready to accept
new jobs.
Report
 [FLS004] [FLS104] The error is reported to the DEM with the error
code FLS_E_ERASE_FAILED.
Depending on the Flash Driver configuration:
 [FLS104] [FLS035] The error shall be polled by the Flash EEPROM
Emulation with the function Fls_GetJobResult (job result set to
MEMIF_JOB_FAILED).
 [FLS263] [FLS168] The error shall be reported to the Flash
EEPROM
Emulation
by
the
callback
function
Fee_JobErrorNotification.
See NVRAM Manager.
Recovery
